## What's new in Igggy 0.1.27
- **Igggy rests while your Mac is idle.** In 0.1.26 the meeting text beside the menu bar icon kept redrawing itself, so Igggy used half to most of one processor core even with nothing recording. It now sits near zero, which your battery and fans will notice. The countdown reads as before, in full-strength text. - **Links are read on your Mac and keep their shape.** A pasted link is read by one reader inside Igggy, with the page's own scripts turned off and its requests kept to the page's own site. The note keeps the page as formatted text under Source Content, headings included and images left out, and the line under the title names the site. Link notes saved before keep their old form. - **YouTube links are written from what was said.** Paste a YouTube link and Igggy writes the note from the video's transcript, fetched from YouTube itself, instead of from the page around it. - **Screenshots, photos of text and scanned pages become notes.** Drop or import a PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, GIF or WebP picture and Igggy reads its text on your Mac and writes a Reference, with the text kept for search and Show Original to open the picture. Drop two or more and Igggy asks: "Do you want these images captured as one reference note or separate notes?" Scanned pages in a PDF are now read instead of skipped, so a fully scanned PDF becomes a note too. A picture with no text, or only a few readable words, is refused on its row with a tip for a sharper shot. The first time, getting text recognition ready can take about a minute, and the row says so. - **Paste a screenshot.** In Add notes, ⌘V with a copied screenshot on the clipboard opens it in Import, the same as dropping it. - **Doubled words are gone from speaker calls.** On a call played through your Mac's speakers, the other person's voice reaches the microphone a moment later, and the transcript used to write their phrase twice. After you stop, Igggy now drops the second copy when three or more of their words repeat within about a second. Your own words are never removed, and headphone calls and voice memos are untouched. - **Try again appears only where it can help.** A link that fails the same way every time (a private document, a paywalled article, a link to a file, a missing page) shows its reason without a Try again button. Offline, a timeout, or a site that's down or busy still offers it. Where a page needs a sign-in or has too little text, the message now suggests a screenshot as well as pasting the text. - **Naming the speakers keeps a note a Meeting.** After you confirm speaker names and rewrite the note, the Rewrite sheet no longer asks Write as. - **Removing a Qwen model waits for the note it's writing.** In Settings → AI Models, Remove now lets the note in progress finish first and says "Removes after the note it's writing is saved." meanwhile. - **The backup card downloads the right model.** When a note was written by the backup because its Qwen model's files were missing, Download Again now fetches that note's own model, and the tooltip says to check the download rather than a key. - **Open-source credits in About Igggy.** Igggy → About Igggy lists the license notices for every open-source library built into the app, including the page reader. - **Also:** the Qwen descriptions in Settings and in setup now say the notes are "written on this Mac."
